verdict.rationale: Grouping chats and files into a project or space is a fair question for an AI agent workspace like Perplexity Computer, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent features: resuming a single session via thread_id and a persistent file workspace in the sandbox VM. Nothing documents a project or space that groups multiple chats and files and shares context and instructions across them.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions
